concept.title: How This Troubleshooting Topic Maintains Itself: A Self-Referential DITA Concept

conbody.p: This topic explains how to structure, update, and extend a DITA troubleshooting topic, using itself as an example.

section.p: How to use: This topic lists common troubleshooting steps for DITA builds. To add new issues, insert additional <li> elements below.

ul.li: Is Java 17+ installed and available in your PATH?
Are all required DITA-OT plugins installed?
On Unix, ensure dita is executable: chmod +x ./dita-ot/bin/dita
Review the build log for missing files or invalid references.

section.p: How to update: Edit the troubleshooting steps above or add new <section> elements for advanced issues.
How to extend: Add new troubleshooting categories as needed, and document their structure here.
